svg.title: A nurse is teaching a community class about the warning signs of cancer. Which findings should the nurse include? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: The CAUTION list: C hange in bowel or bladder habits, A sore that does not heal, U nusual bleeding or discharge, T hickening or a lump, I ndigestion or difficulty swallowing, O bvious change in a wart or mole, N agging cough or hoarseness. Unexplained weight loss is the concerning direction, not gain.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Oncologic Disorders & End-of-Life
Care
Read the situation
A nurse is teaching a community class
about the warning signs of cancer. Which
findings should the nurse include? Select
all that apply.
What fits here
A sore that does not heal · Unusual
bleeding or discharge · A change in a wart
or mole · A nagging cough or hoarseness
Why it fits

U nusual bleeding or discharge, T
hickening or a lump, I ndigestion or
difficulty swallowing, O bvious change in
